disposition_semantics.excluded_from_public_package: Do not include in a publishable build. A file may still be physically present in this review package only because the entire package is explicitly do_not_publish.

summary.claim_boundary: The package-level exclusion is an explicit review boundary, not proof that excluded bytes have already been removed. Eight affected groups normalize to two root publication-evidence gaps, five inherited delivery groups, and one conditional public-brand item; they must not be scored as eight independent defects.
